connector.name: Upload-Post
connector.registryDescription: Social media MCP: publish, schedule & analyze posts on TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn & X
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.upload-post.com over streamable HTTP. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.upload-post, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional. Your Upload-Post API key as 'ApiKey <key>' (or 'Bearer <key>'). Omit to use the OAuth flow instead.
